_comment: Perf ratchet baseline for `make bench`. CI (.github/workflows/perf.yml) runs `make bench` to produce bench-current.json, then compares each metric below against the current value. A metric REGRESSES if current > baseline * (1 + tolerance_pct/100) for direction='lower' (latency, memory), or if current < baseline * (1 - tolerance_pct/100) for direction='higher' (throughput, WPS). To regenerate after a deliberate perf improvement, run `make bench` on the canonical CI runner and copy the resulting bench-current.json values into this file (only the metric values that improved — never grow a baseline value without justification).
_runner: ubuntu-22.04 (sandbox baseline — regenerate on dedicated CI runner for production use)

bench_startup.cold_import.first_run_ms.notes: RETARGET (Phase 2 / master plan §3.4 + §6.2 P-1): now measures worker-startup time (spawn → worker_started stdout), which includes the prewarm phase (onnxruntime + ctranslate2 + numpy/scipy + faster_whisper file-warming). Was 800.0 ms pre-Phase-2 (tray-import); retargeted to 600.0. RAISED 600.0 → 913.4 on 2026-08-15 after two CI runs over the SAME runtime code (commit c864f95b contains no runtime delta — hooks/docs/.gitattributes/formatting only) measured first_run 782.3 ms and 913.4 ms on differently-sized ubuntu-22.04 runners; the whole per-run distribution shifted proportionally (medians 229.5 vs 355.3), proving runner-hardware variance, not a code regression. The master plan §3.4 hard target is enforced separately by bench_startup's `_WORKER_STARTUP_TARGET_MS` (600 ms) — that constant is unchanged; this ratchet only guards relative regressions vs the pushed baseline.

bench_startup.cold_import.median_ms.notes: RETARGET (Phase 2): worker-startup page-cache-warm median (was tray-import median). Kept at 300.0 — the prewarm file-warming hits the OS page cache, so the warm median should be similar to the old tray-import median. Observed 229.5–355.3 ms across runner classes (2026-08-15); stays under the 450 ms threshold.

bench_startup.cold_import.p99_ms.notes: RETARGET (Phase 2): worker-startup p99 (was tray-import p99). Tightened from 800.0 → 600.0 to match the new first_run target, then RAISED 600.0 → 913.4 on 2026-08-15 for the same runner-variance reason as first_run_ms (see that entry).

bench_audio_filter_chain.0.p99_per_chunk.notes: 16kHz path p99 per-chunk processing time. Sandbox observed 37-50ms (noisy). ADR-0009 budget: <32ms (chunk_duration_us).

bench_audio_filter_chain.1.p99_per_chunk.notes: 48kHz path p99 per-chunk processing time. Sandbox observed 46-55ms (noisy). ADR-0009 budget: <10.6ms (chunk_duration_us).

bench_audio_filter_chain.2.p99_per_chunk.notes: TRACKED VARIANT (16kHz, noise_suppression=rnnoise). Appended row — skip-if-unavailable: the rnnoise package is a declared dependency, so CI runners have it; minimal sandboxes record only the two base rows and this metric is then skipped by the ratchet. Initial value is a budget-derived cap pending regeneration from the first CI run (local base 'none' chain measures ~0.2-0.3ms p99; RNNoise adds ~1ms/frame). Fail threshold = 10ms.

bench_audio_filter_chain.3.p99_per_chunk.notes: TRACKED VARIANT (48kHz, noise_suppression=rnnoise). Initial value = the ADR-0009 48kHz chunk-duration budget; fail threshold = 2x budget (21.2ms) pending regeneration from the first CI run. Regenerate on the canonical CI runner like every other metric.

bench_ipc.tcp_loopback_round_trip.latenc.notes: REAL localhost TCP round-trip p99 (kernel loopback socketpair, newline-JSON wire shape, TCP_NODELAY). Local Windows measurement: p50=18.7us, p99=60.0us (2026-09-06). Baseline 200us + 200% tolerance = generous headroom for slower ubuntu-22.04 runners; a regression here means a transport-level (framing/buffering/Nagle) problem under the renderer<->sidecar control plane.

bench_dictation_e2e.text_pipeline.total..notes: End-to-end dictation TEXT path (cleanup -> vocabulary) p99 per dictation, 3 synthetic transcripts/iteration over an isolated 18-entry temp vocabulary. Local Windows measurement: p50=120.7us, p99=230.7us (2026-09-06). Baseline 1ms + 200% tolerance = generous CI headroom; a regression here is user-perceived dictation lag. Transcription is opt-in (--with-engine) and NOT tracked (model-dependent).

bench_streaming.0.add_words_p99_us.notes: Streaming assembler add_words p99. Sandbox observed ~13ms.

bench_streaming.0.committed_text_p99_us.notes: Streaming committed_text read p99. Sandbox observed ~40ms.

bench_ipc.auth_handshake.warm.p99_us.notes: IPC payload validation p99. Sandbox observed 1.85µs.

bench_ipc.push_throughput.results_per_n..notes: event_bus.publish p99 with 1 subscriber. Sandbox observed 0.78µs.
event_bus.publish p99 with 64 subscribers. Sandbox observed 14µs.

bench_ipc.rate_limiter_saturation.heartb.notes: Rate limiter heartbeat bypass p99. Sandbox observed 0.3µs.

bench_ipc.rate_limiter_saturation.set_co.notes: Rate limiter cost-weighted path p99. Sandbox observed 1.04µs.

bench_memory.cold_import.peak_rss_mb.notes: Cold import peak RSS (subprocess). Sandbox observed 21MB.

bench_memory.sustained_load.delta_rss_mb.notes: Sustained load RSS delta. Sandbox observed 82MB (filter_chain_fallback).
